messages:
Noah Rivera: Quick note 0min0ago: sample-app README uses `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'` which breaks for strict ESM TS setups (no esModuleInterop). Users hitting `TypeError: Redwood is not a constructor`.

Maya Chen: Yikes. That's the old default-style snippet. We ship a named factory `createClient`.

Liam O'Connor: Can you paste the exact lines?

Noah Rivera: Current:```ts
import Redwood from 'redwood-inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
```

Maya Chen: Fix should be simple:```ts
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference';
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
```

Liam O'Connor: Also add CommonJS example so copy/paste works for Node demos.

Maya Chen: I'll open a docs PR with README change + tiny FAQ note about `esModuleInterop` and why we prefer named exports. Will add a smoke CI step: pack + run a tiny ESM TS project.

doc-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/536 "sample-app README: switch to named createClient + FAQ"

ci-bot: CI started for docs/pr-961 0min ago 0(lint + smoke tests).

Noah Rivera: Thanks, folks. Adding an onboarding checklist note for SEs would help demos.

Maya Chen: Added checklist update in PR description. Will merge once CI passes.

ci-bot: CI passed 0min later. PR merged.
